lead.title: Oxford spinout Genomics Ltd extends its human-genetics target discovery alliance with Vertex by four years, in a deal that could exceed $220M
lead.deck: On November 18, Peter Donnelly's company announced the extension of the target discovery and validation collaboration it struck with Vertex in 2018: potential value exceeds $220M in research, development, regulatory and commercial milestones, plus tiered royalties on sales. Vertex, a Genomics shareholder since 2018, is signing up for four more years of a platform (a genotype-phenotype database and the Mystra tool) that uses human genetic variation to pick targets and biomarkers, a rare traction signal for a still-independent European techbio.

milestone.title: Innate Pharma's Nectin-4 ADC IPH4502 shows responses in urothelial cancer patients already treated with enfortumab vedotin
milestone.summary: Presented at ENA 2026, dose escalation enrolled 76 heavily pretreated patients (median 3.5 prior lines): among the 19 urothelial cancer patients previously given Padcev, there were three partial responses (one confirmed) and an unconfirmed disease control rate of 68.4%, with responses regardless of Nectin-4 expression level. Stomatitis was the only dose-limiting toxicity, with no neuropathy or febrile neutropenia; a dose-optimization phase is due to start in the first half of 2027.
milestone.why: Padcev (enfortumab vedotin) now dominates advanced bladder cancer, and patients who relapse after it have few options: an ADC hitting the same target with a different payload (exatecan, a topoisomerase I inhibitor) that still works there would open a niche. Patient numbers remain very small, hence the caution.

deal.thesis: The Oslo biotech raises NOK 80M at NOK 8 per share from Norwegian private investors (Saturn Invest, HIFO Invest, TAJ Holding, Jakob Hatteland Holding, Per Strand Eiendom), with no named lead and about 12% dilution, ten days after its NeoLIPA phase II success in melanoma. The money prepares a registrational phase III of ruxotemitide in the neoadjuvant setting and moves LTX-401 toward phase I, but the phase III itself will need a partner or more funding: a typical bridge round for a Nordic oncolytic waiting for pharma.

brefsEurope.title: Priavoid's Alzheimer's pill PRI-002 misses its primary efficacy endpoint in phase 2, despite signals at 72 weeks
brefsEurope.summary: The PRImus-AD trial (304 patients, 38 sites in six European countries) showed no significant effect on CDR-SB at 48 weeks; only ADAS-Cog13 at 72 weeks, per protocol, slowed decline by 35.9% (p=0.022), with very little ARIA-E edema. The oral all-D peptide, designed to dismantle amyloid oligomers, will be reassessed before any new study.

brefsEurope.title: Oncoinvent: independent committee clears the randomized phase 2 of Radspherin in ovarian cancer peritoneal metastases to continue unchanged
brefsEurope.summary: The first safety analysis, covering 56 patients (40 treated), found no serious adverse events related to this alpha radiopharmaceutical injected into the abdomen after surgery; 74 patients have been randomized. Full enrollment is expected in the first half of 2027, with a first efficacy readout in April 2027.

brefsEurope.title: Roche starts the phase 2 ZYNERGY trial combining Zealand's petrelintide with its dual GLP-1/GIP agonist enicepatide in obesity
brefsEurope.summary: About 480 patients will test three weekly combinations of the amylin analog and Roche's incretin against placebo and each drug alone, with weight loss at 40 weeks as the primary endpoint. A comparable for the obesity market: amylin + incretin combinations are becoming the core of the partnership signed in 2025.

brefsEurope.title: TreeFrog Therapeutics hires James Sterling, former bluebird bio CFO who led Renalytix's IPOs, as chief financial officer
brefsEurope.summary: The Bordeaux biotech, which mass-produces stem cells with its C-Stem technology and targets Parkinson's disease first, hands finance, investor relations and corporate development to a CFO who has run listings in London and on Nasdaq. It has raised $82M since 2021: a hire that often precedes the next round.

brefsEurope.title: European Commission extends approval of Tryngolza (olezarsen), the RNA-targeted therapy marketed by Sobi, to severe hypertriglyceridemia
brefsEurope.summary: Originated by Ionis, the monthly autoinjector cut triglycerides by up to 73% versus placebo and acute pancreatitis by 83% in the phase 3 CORE and CORE2 trials. Sobi holds rights outside the US, Canada and China: a comparable for the rise of oligonucleotides in common cardiometabolic diseases.

brefsEurope.title: Ellipses Pharma explores a London Stock Exchange listing via a reverse takeover by SPAC Wolfram Resources
brefsEurope.summary: A non-binding memorandum of understanding has Wolfram buying Ellipses for shares ahead of a relisting on the Main Market, alongside an undisclosed fundraise, targeted for early 2027. Ellipses is developing a selective RET inhibitor (EP0031, partnered with Kelun-Biotech) and an oral SARM in breast cancer, both in phase 2.

brefsEurope.title: EktaH wins €2.4M through Bpifrance's i-Démo program for its phase IIa in obesity
brefsEurope.summary: Founded in 2021 on fifteen years of academic research into fat taste receptors, the Dijon startup is preparing an exploratory phase IIa in Tunisia to generate the clinical data investors want. CEO Xavier Boidevezi says a US fund is ready to invest if a European investor leads the ongoing round.

brefsEurope.title: Novo Nordisk Foundation raises its support for CARB-X, the antimicrobial resistance accelerator, to $60M over four years
brefsEurope.summary: Up from an initial $25M in 2024, the Danish foundation funds the public-private partnership that gives grants to antibiotics, vaccines and early diagnostics, with Gram-negative bacteria as a priority. CARB-X, which accepts projects from anywhere in the world, is a key source of non-dilutive funding for European anti-infective startups.

brefsIntl.title: Pfizer moves into in vivo CAR-T: $330M upfront for three preclinical programs from China's Starna, worth up to $2.6B
brefsIntl.summary: Pfizer gets ex-Greater China rights to three autoimmune programs based on RNA that reprograms immune cells directly inside the body, with up to $2.3B in milestones. A comparable that prices in vivo CAR-T for European biotechs in the field, just as Novartis and BMS have paused CAR-T trials in autoimmunity.

brefsIntl.title: Biocon's pertuzumab Pebrilzo becomes the first biosimilar authorized in the EU under the EMA's new tailored clinical approach
brefsIntl.summary: The authorization, following a positive CHMP opinion in September, relies on comparative pharmacokinetic data to demonstrate similarity. A lighter regulatory path that lowers the entry cost for antibody biosimilars in Europe.

word.definition: A treatment that attaches a radioactive atom emitting alpha particles to a guide molecule (antibody, peptide, small molecule) to irradiate cancer cells at very close range, across just a few cells.

parts.label: Chelator
parts.role: the clamp that holds the atom

how.t: The vector binds a receptor overexpressed by the tumor (PSMA, SSTR2…) or, for Radspherin, the radium is injected straight into the abdominal cavity.
The atom emits alpha particles that travel only 20 to 100 µm, i.e. 2 to 10 cell diameters, depositing a huge amount of energy.
That highly concentrated energy causes clustered, hard-to-repair double-strand breaks that kill the cell even when it is poorly oxygenated or not dividing.

word.why: Beta radioligands (lutetium-177) proved the model; alpha promises more potency over a shorter range, including after lutetium fails. The bottleneck is isotope supply (actinium-225, lead-212) and manufacturing: mega-rounds such as AdvanCell's fund plants as much as clinics, and a biotech that controls its isotope chain commands a premium.

startups.name: Oncoinvent
startups.use: Radspherin, radium-224 microparticles injected into the peritoneum after surgery; randomized phase 2 in ovarian cancer

startups.name: Ariceum Therapeutics
startups.use: 225Ac-SSO110, an actinium-225-labelled SSTR2 antagonist; phase I/II SANTANA-225 in small cell lung cancer and Merkel cell carcinoma

startups.name: AdvanCell
startups.use: Lead-212 platform; PSMA-targeted ADVC001 in phase 2 in prostate cancer, $315M Series D in July 2026

startups.name: Convergent Therapeutics
startups.use: CONV01-α, an actinium-225 anti-PSMA radioantibody; phase 2 data at ASCO 2026 after lutetium-PSMA failure
